posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Interesting, and a bit weird.  I'm not sure if you go faster if you move more or if you move less.  Typically tactics games grant bonus speed for taking fewer actions or moving less, but the "Quick" category name implies that "quick" characters, i.e. ones that move more, go first--plus it would be more thematic with the Sentinels characters (Tachyon, who runs around a lot, should go early, while Bunker, who often doesn't move at all, should go late).

Also, the way it's written, it seems like every character gets slower every round except the hero that goes first, which would mean they'd all bottom out eventually.  But on re-reading it a couple of times, I'm thinking that the speed category for each round is based on how much you moved in the previous round, minus one "category" if you didn't go first (meaning that you'd be immune to the penalty either if you went first or if you were in the slowest category based on your movement anyway).

There's also a hint at some sort of "squad" mechanic that I'm sure we'll hear more about later on.

posts.name: UglyOrangeFish
posts.cooked:
MindWanderer:

Interesting, and a bit weird.  I'm not sure if you go faster if you move more or if you move less.  Typically tactics games grant bonus speed for taking fewer actions or moving less, but the "Quick" category name implies that "quick" characters, i.e. ones that move more, go first–plus it would be more thematic with the Sentinels characters (Tachyon, who runs around a lot, should go early, while Bunker, who often doesn't move at all, should go late).Also, the way it's written, it seems like every character gets slower every round except the hero that goes first, which would mean they'd all bottom out eventually.  But on re-reading it a couple of times, I'm thinking that the speed category for each round is based on how much you moved in the previous round, minus one "category" if you didn't go first (meaning that you'd be immune to the penalty either if you went first or if you were in the slowest category based on your movement anyway).There's also a hint at some sort of "squad" mechanic that I'm sure we'll hear more about later on.

Right, we felt that if a character was already running - they would have the jump on characterst that are standing still - though if they get a bad roll they could still be going later.

For Speed catagory, yes, it is based on how much you moved in the previous round (total).  The penalty will just drop you one catagory - unless your 1st.

On your last comment, we will be explaining more later but enemies can form squads which will give them access to unique ablitlties and heroes have support actions that allow attacks\actions to be enhanced by other heroes - such as distraction or assisted reload.
